exceptions.reason: All ten complete source questions are easy. No moderate/hard instructional backbone is evidenced. This package retains dimension exclusion and immediate pivot inspection; more demanding row reduction would change the assessed method. New evidence reopens classification.

Only complete observed choice profiles and explicitly enumerated pivot-rank edits are supported. Numerical rescaling, option order, seed and relabeling never add capacity. This is a package limit, not global mathematical impossibility.
